scope: The 5 admitted X509_VERIFY_POLICY production obligation(s) in src/x509/v3_attrdesc.rs that the enumerated SSH closure reports as reachable but without an owning boundary receipt are enumerated here for ownership only, at their census coordinates, with a hazard read from each function. This receipt claims no discharge, no contract and no new reachability finding.
non_claims: This receipt does not discharge any site, and no site may be treated as discharged on its authority.
This receipt does not contract any site; the hazard notes are enumeration notes, not established contracts.
This receipt does not assert reachability; reachability is taken from the enumerated closure and is not re-established here.

boundaries.hazard: Raw OSSL_HASH is dereferenced; algorithmIdentifier, parameter and hashValue are forwarded to ASN.1/attribute printers, and a NULL hashValue returns 0.
Raw OSSL_INFO_SYNTAX_POINTER is dereferenced; its name and hash members are forwarded to raw printers when non-NULL.
Raw OSSL_INFO_SYNTAX is dereferenced and the type_ selector chooses content bytes or the pointer arm; an unknown selector returns 0.
Raw OSSL_PRIVILEGE_POLICY_ID is dereferenced; its object is formatted into an 80-byte buffer and privPolSyntax is forwarded to a raw printer.
Raw OSSL_ATTRIBUTE_DESCRIPTOR is dereferenced; identifier, attributeSyntax and name are printed through OBJ/BIO with lengths taken from ASN.1 strings.
